description: Search contacts (Kontakte) in sevDesk: organisations and persons, such as customers (Kunden), suppliers (Lieferanten), partners and prospects (Interessenten). Filter by name, exact customer number (Kundennummer) and category. sevDesk does the name matching against organisation names and persons' first and last names; if nothing is found, try a shorter or different part of the name. Results are compact and paged (limit/offset, total, hasMore). Use detail=summary to browse/find. Use sevdesk_contact_get for addresses, emails and phone numbers.

detail.description: Use summary to browse/find; full (default) or the matching get tool for details.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset.

query.description: Name or part of a name, e.g. 'Musterfirma' or 'Mustermann'.

name: sevdesk_contacts_search
title: Search sevDesk contacts
